note: Values verify:secrets flagged that a person has read and confirmed are not credentials. A fingerprint identifies a rule plus a value, never a path, so moving a file does not silently reopen a decision and one fixture value reused across several files is one entry. Every entry needs a reason of at least 20 characters: 'false positive' is not a reason. Adding an entry is a statement that you opened the file and looked. If a finding turns out to be real, an entry here is not the fix; the credential is compromised and has to be rotated. Note that the scanner's own test file is NOT exempted by path, deliberately, because a path exemption is the hole this gate exists to close. Its fixtures are listed here one by one instead.
